intro: Every official GTA 6 video from Rockstar, newest first. Videos play here from Rockstar's own YouTube channel.

sources.title: Rockstar Games – GTA VI official videos
Game Informer – pre-order date and cover art video

items.title: Pre-Load Now
items.text: A 29-second spot set to Tove Lo's "Blood in Your Eyes", with unseen scenes. It marked pre-loading opening on 10 November.

items.title: Launch Trailer
items.text: The final trailer before release, captured in-game on PS5. It debuts "Flower in a Hurricane" by Justice with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard.

items.title: An Extended Look
items.text: 26 minutes of in-game footage: switching between Jason and Lucia, six wanted stars, combat, racing, diving and more. It premiered on Netflix, then YouTube.

items.title: Cover Art and Pre-Order Reveal
items.text: The official cover art is revealed, and pre-orders are announced for 25 June.

items.title: Trailer 2
items.text: Jason and Lucia's story: an easy score goes wrong and drags them into a conspiracy across Vice City and Leonida.

items.title: Trailer 1
items.text: The reveal of Vice City and Leonida, set to Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road". It set a record for the most-viewed game trailer in 24 hours.
